facts.text: Jon expressed gratitude to Gina for her belief in him, stating that her faith in him is a real boost.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Gina! Your faith in me is a real boost. I'm gonna make my dreams come true!
Thanks, Gina! Your belief in me means the world.

facts.text: Jon vowed not to let anything or anyone stop him from achieving his dreams.

evidence.quote: I'm not gonna let anything or anyone stop me. I'll keep pushing and make my dreams come true.

facts.text: Jon thanked Gina for being a great friend and acknowledged her support as significant to his determination.

evidence.quote: Thanks for being a great friend. You rock!

facts.text: Jon expressed his commitment to continue pushing toward his dreams despite the challenges he faces.

evidence.quote: I won't quit, even when it's hard. I'm gonna make it!
